title: nb: input validation gaps reported in the spec review (unverified)
body:
Found in the spec-vs-code review of branch `worktree-agent-af4147e78b41b3bce` on 2026-11-09. Line numbers are that branch.

Reported by reviewers with reproductions; not re-checked.

- `--artifact` paths are stored as typed, not relative to the repo root; only `--metrics` is relativised. Lint resolves artifacts against the root.
- `--reason ""` is accepted by `nb invalidate` and `nb reject`, and the empty reason is not logged.
- A multi-line title is accepted; SPEC says one line.
- `nb config set` checks only the value's type (`pending_days -3`, empty `auditor_model`), and its usage errors exit 1, not 2.
- `--user-words` is stored without `--origin`, and with `--origin claude`.
- `--fresh` and a `variant-of` or `uses` link can coexist.
- Unlinking `supersedes` from an open hypothesis leaves the old one superseded.
